name: codle
description: Retos diarios de programación estilo Wordle

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -n db,api,web -c green,blue,magenta "npm run db -w server" "npm run dev:seeded -w server" "npm run dev -w client -- --open"
